kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
انغسلت (form VII)
# اِنْغَسَلْتُ (inḡasaltu) /in.ɣa.sal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْغَسَلَ (inḡasala)
# اِنْغَسَلْتَ (inḡasalta) /in.ɣa.sal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْغَسَلَ (inḡasala)
# اِنْغَسَلْتِ (inḡasalti) /in.ɣa.sal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْغَسَلَ (inḡasala)
# اِنْغَسَلَتْ (inḡasalat) /in.ɣa.sa.lat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
